answer: Because the anchor solution is checked at the cipher gate and logged, the timber audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 26 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch thus pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. A farm of 198 pays that 79 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
